cheat.name: Wild Pokemon Modifier v1
cheat.note: (Press L+R): You will get 649 Master Ball and 100 Ultra Ball, toss to change amounts to Pokemon number and level respectively. Press Select before heading into grass.

cheat.name: Wild Pokemon Modifier v2
cheat.note: (Press L+R): Make the first two items in you Items Bag have an amount 649 and 100. Toss the number of items needed to get the national Pokedex number for the Pokemon wanted for the first item and the level number for the second item. Press Select, then go encounter a wild Pokemon.

cheat.name: Encounter Random Wild Pokemon
cheat.note: Randomizes the Pokemon in the wild.

cheat.name: Dream World Pokemon Encounters
cheat.note: (Press L+R): Make the first two items in you Items Bag to have an amount 649 and 100. Toss the number of items needed to get the national Pokedex number for the Pokemon wanted for the first item and the level number for the second item. Hold Select and press A at the Wii in your room. To encounter a Pokemon with it's Dream World Ability.

cheat.name: Choose Pokémon and level
cheat.note: Requires melonDS with the Sacred Gold Plus selector. Tap this entry to search 493 Pokémon by name or Pokédex number and choose a level from 1 to 100. The initial choice is Pikachu, level 5. In melonDS 2.1.1 the selector starts off: L+R toggles it on/off; release both buttons between presses. Does not use Bag Balls. Tall grass only; turn Wild levels off in the game options. Unown requires a completed Ruins of Alph puzzle. On melonDS without the selector this code directly sets Pikachu at level 5; folders 49–59 remain available for manual selection.

cheat.name: Pokémon selvatici con IV massimi
cheat.note: This will maximize all the wild Pokemon's IVs. WARNING: Using this will make the Pokemon illegal to trade and use online in Pokemon generations 6-7.

cheat.name: Scegli il livello dei Pokémon selvatici (classic method)
cheat.note: Classic method for the level only. Hold L + R to receive 100 Ultra Balls, discard them until the count equals the level you want, then hold L in tall grass. Tall grass only. Easier: one entry from folder 49.

cheat.name: Livello 1
cheat.note: Always on: wild Pokemon will be level 1. It patches the encounter code, so it covers grass, Surf, fishing and special encounters. Its guard (0x02246C94) was re-read from the 1.2.1 image and matches, so the code writes: an encounter was measured headless on 1.2.1 English. Do not combine it with the "wild levels" setting on the Options page.

Its guard (0x02246C94) was re-read from the 1.2.1 image and matches, so the code writes: an encounter was measured headless on 1.2.1 English. Do not combine it with the "wild levels" setting on the Options page.

cheat.name: READ ME - how to use this folder
cheat.note: Switch ONE species on in these folders and ONE level in folder 49, then hold L while walking in tall grass. This entry carries no code: switching it on does nothing. Species apply to tall grass and radio calls only, not to Surf, fishing, Rock Smash or Headbutt; alternate forms come out in their base form and Unown may not appear. No Master Balls to discard: the classic method stays in folder 40.
